newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar closes flat in moderate volume.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar closes flat in moderate volume.

text.p: The Canadian dollar closed almost flat at C$1.3411 (US$0.7457) from Wednesday's close of C$1.3413 (US$0.7455) in steady volumes, dealers said.
"There was continued interest to buy Canada throughout the day," said one trader.
The Canadian currency strengthened a full Canadian cent on Wednesday and continued its rally into Thursday morning on investors' bullish interest in the Canadian economy, dealers said.
But the currency took a turn in the early afternoon as market players put the brakes on the recent surge.
Medium-term players helped push the currency down on expectations of a slight correction, traders said.
"It was a bit more cautious in its climb higher," noted one dealer.
The market will be closely watching for Canada's merchandise trade numbers on Friday, traders said.

Economists in a Reuter survey have forecast that Canada's merchandise trade balance will show a surplus of C$2.92 billion in November, compared to a C$1.49 billion surplus in October. If the numbers are stronger than expected, the Canadian dollar should rally, traders said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1897 marks from Wednesday's close of 1.1820 marks but dropped to 86.91 yen from 87.04 yen.
